{{Quote|There is no contemplation, there is only duty.|The Sixth Line's creed|<ref name="TOR:APoZ">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=faction|Republic|A Presence on Ziost|Ziost}}</ref>}}
The '''Sixth Line''' was a militant faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that was active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire.]] They took their name from the "sixth line" that they added to the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]: "There is no contemplation, there is only duty." Led by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Surro]] and several other Masters, the Sixth Line worked as a strike unit for the Republic, primarily on the orders of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]. The Sixth Line was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in the aftermath of [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]]'s failed defense of the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]].

Later in the war, when [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Theron Shan]] discovered that the former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] was active on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], he called the Sixth Line to Ziost, but Vitiate possessed the entire Sixth Line along with the planet's population. The vast majority of the Sixth Line [[Death/Legends|perished]] in the cataclysmic [[Invasion of Ziost]].

Years after, during the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with Tenebrae, members of the Sixth Line were among the spirits witnessing his final death.<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|[[Kira Carsen's ship]]}}</ref>
